title: Figures 24-25: Bjork-Shiley heart valve photo and stent placement illustration
description: A photograph of a ring-shaped mechanical valve with a tilting disc is captioned "Figure 24. Stainless Steel and Teflon Bjork Shiley Heart Valve". Below, a medical illustration of an artery cross-section labeled "Dilated balloon catheter and stent", "Stent deployed" and "Plaque" is captioned "Figure 25. Illustration of Stent Placement." The page opens the 'Stent Biomaterials' section.
